CLIC_snapshot.source: TI manufacturer material-content reports https://www.ti.com/quality-reliability-packaging-download/de-de/report?opn=LM5168FQDDARQ1 ; ?opn=TXU0204QPWRQ1 ; ?opn=CC2662R1FTWRGZRQ1 , accessed2026-10-18; TI TIDA020076 fitted BOM and CC2662 WBMS controller guide.
CLIC_snapshot.comment:
Local reviewed candidate: electronics_components:C125-C128-C138:R109-R132. Original published histories remain immutable.
Actual die geometry/node/site, fused-silica purity/fusion, proprietary fractions and complete package manufacture remain unverified

Historical source/refinement provenance (superseded where qualified above):
Chosen allocation thickness: 270um; silicon density2330kg/m3. C127 qualified package-reference preview. Select exactly the first TI material declaration per named package; never add alternate assembly-site tables. The chosen wafer allocation is an engineering reference, not measured die thickness, node, fab geography or actual device yield. Native fabricated wafer supply already includes its own raw-wafer yield and FEOL/BEOL burdens. Do not add raw silicon, a second yield multiplier, complete packaged IC or board assembly again. Preserve other material doses, uncertainty, suppliers, package assembly energy, board counts/mass and retirement. Silica sand for silica/fused silica, low-alloy steel for Fe, resin and elemental feed choices remain qualified proxies; fusion/purity/packaging operations are not certified. Proprietary fractions are explicitly unassigned, not normalized away. One TXU0204/one LM5168 per70g monitor and one CC2662 proxy per490g central board are scoped references, not proof of complete electronics coverage. The TI monitor BOM also lists U5 CC2662R1FRGZT; it is not silently equated to the central automotive part or added on top of the unresolved interface allowance. Actual isolation/other MCU and interface ownership remain separate cases. Original source descriptions below are historical provenance, not current claims that an assumed300um die was measured.

TI manufacturer material-content reports https://www.ti.com/quality-reliability-packaging-download/de-de/report?opn=LM5168FQDDARQ1 ; ?opn=TXU0204QPWRQ1 ; ?opn=CC2662R1FTWRGZRQ1 , accessed2026-10-18; TI TIDA020076 fitted BOM and CC2662 WBMS controller guide. Use one explicitly selected first returned material declaration per part, never sum alternative assembly-site tables. LM5168 FlyBuck regulator,TXU0204 logic translator andCC2662 WBMS MCU have distinct die,frame,bonds,mold and plating. Sum constituent rows excluding subtotals to recover declared package mass. Retain actual Zn alloying,Ag attach and Au/Pd plating; no arbitraryZn-for-Sb conversion or global antimony deletion. Sb is not listed in these selected declarations, which is not proof of analyticalzeroSb in all electronics. Purchase fabricated die wafer area from declared Si mass at explicit300micrometrethickness,2330kg/m3; no second rawSi charge. Silica-sand supply is an explicit fused-silica proxy with missing fusion/purity energy. Fe uses lowalloy steel proxy, resin uses epoxy/phenolic analogues, elementalP/chlorine feeds are nominal material proxies. Proprietary composition remains unresolved. Package assembly1kWh/kg and100%final retention are engineering assumptions,not suppliermeasured yield or complete semiconductor packaging LCI. Module priorlogic allowances1.5g and0.4g are replaced by oneTXU and oneLM5168 package,consistent with fitted reference parts; released mass remains explicitly unresolved board components. Other actualMCU/isolation packages are still coveragegaps,not proven identical. Central5gMCU allowance becomes oneCC2662 (firstselectedsite) and residual mass,not dozens of fictitious MCU packages. BQ79616 monitor package unchanged. Fixed70g/490g board budgets and their downstream endoflife retained. No motherboard/chassis electronics added. Process service, film,purity,actualsite and unknown-component sensitivity remain necessary; no certifiedexactvehicleBOM claim.
